records.text: No fluxonium QEC round has been run; no idle/memory error per round is published
records.note: Honest null: fluxonium work reports coherence and gate fidelity only, no syndrome-extraction cycle.

desc.en: Harmonic mode of a 3D/planar superconducting resonator; single-photon T1 10 ms (Al, Yale 2013), cavity-qubit T2 34 ms (Weizmann 2023); errors = photon loss (structured).
desc.ru: Гармоническая мода 3D/планарного сверхпроводящего резонатора; T1 фотона 10 мс (Al, Yale 2013), T2 полостного кубита 34 мс (Weizmann 2023); ошибки — потеря фотона (структурированная).

attrs.en: The 25.6 ms / 34 ms figures are Weizmann (Milul/Rosenblum, PRX Quantum 4, 030336), not a Yale-lineage result; the cavity material is not stated, so 'Nb-coated' is unsupported.
attrs.ru: Значения 25.6 мс / 34 мс — Weizmann (Milul/Rosenblum, PRX Quantum 4, 030336), а не результат линии Yale; материал полости не указан, поэтому «покрытие Nb» не подтверждено.

records.text: Weizmann long-lived superconducting cavity: single-photon T1 = 25.6 ms
records.note: Same experiment stored a 1024-photon Schroedinger cat; Yale Al cavity (2013) gave 10 ms.

records.text: Weizmann: single-photon-encoded cavity qubit coherence T2 = 34 ms
records.note: T2 > T1 because the encoded qubit is protected against the dominant loss channel.

records.text: A bosonic mode has no intrinsic 1Q gate; the gate is ancilla- or beam-splitter-mediated and is recorded on g_bos (~200 ns)
records.note: Null to avoid duplicating g_bos: the mechanism, not the carrier, defines the single-qubit gate.

records.text: No cavity-qubit QEC round with a published per-round idle error; dual-rail 1Q gate erasure is ~0.1%
records.note: Honest null: bosonic results are quoted per gate (erasure, Pauli), never per syndrome round.

desc.en: Yb⁺/Ba⁺/Ca⁺ ions in RF traps; motional coupling (MHz) bounds gates at µs; hour-scale memory.

attrs.en: Quantinuum Helios 98 q; IonQ Tempo 100 q chain.

records.text: Single 171Yb+ memory: T1 = 11,902 +/- 2,209 s from the process-matrix fit
records.note: Single-ion memory experiment, not a processor; hyperfine T1 is effectively unbounded in a processor.

records.text: Single 171Yb+ with KDDxy DD (0.4 s interpulse): T2 = 4,235 +/- 576 s; |0>,|1> coherence 15,943 +/- 3,190 s
records.note: 'Over one hour' headline; a working processor is limited by transport, not by this T2.

records.text: Ion 1Q gate time is set by the drive mechanism: laser Raman 110 us (g_ms, IonQ Forte); near-field microwave 8 us (g_elec)
records.note: Null on the carrier by design - the mechanism defines it; see g_ms and g_elec t1q records.

records.text: Quantinuum Helios (98 q): linear memory error rate 5(1)e-4 per qubit per transport-idle step; quadratic term 0.7(2)e-4
records.note: Matches the H2 datasheet 'memory error per qubit per operation' typical 5e-4 (range 2e-4 to 2e-3).

records.text: Helios: single-qubit gate leakage 1.12(6)e-5 per Clifford; ternary readout shows 4.2(7)e-3 leakage population after prep
records.note: Leakage is detected without ancillas via the ternary measurement, so it converts to erasure.

desc.en: Hyperfine qubit; Rydberg interaction (MHz–GHz) allows sub-µs gates; T2 ~1–13 s; dominant error is atom loss.
desc.ru: Сверхтонкий кубит; ридберговское взаимодействие (МГц–ГГц) допускает суб-мкс гейты; T2 ~1–13 с; доминирующая ошибка — потеря атома.

records.text: Caltech 6,100-atom Cs tweezer array: room-temperature trapping lifetime 23 minutes
records.note: Trap (atom-loss) lifetime, not a spin T1; hyperfine T1 is not the limiting quantity for alkali.

records.text: Caltech 6,100 Cs atoms in ~12,000 tweezers: hyperfine qubit coherence T2 = 12.6(1) s
records.note: Harvard/QuEra 448-atom processor quotes only T2 > 1 s for its hyperfine clock states.

records.text: Harvard/QuEra 448-atom processor: global Raman path at ~0.5 MHz Rabi gives ~5 us rotations (composite pulses)
records.note: Global drive, so all qubits rotate together; measured scattering error 5e-5 per SCROFULOUS pulse.

records.text: Not separately quantified: the 448-atom paper reports only combined logical error 0.62(3)% per round (d=5) and a 4 ms cycle
records.note: Honest null: idle/transport dephasing is folded into the logical per-round figure, not decomposed.

records.text: 87Rb CZ: leakage to F=1 0.008(1)% per atom per gate (Rydberg T1 decay + intermediate-state scattering)
records.note: Atom loss is much larger, 0.054(2)% per atom per CZ (~60% of the total gate error).

desc.en: Nuclear-spin / clock-state qubits with metastable levels; decays are detectable → erasures (98% theory, 56% shown).

attrs.en: Atom Computing (Yb), Princeton, Caltech (Sr), Pasqal (Rb→?)
attrs.ru: Atom Computing (Yb), Princeton, Caltech (Sr).

records.text: 171Yb nuclear-spin qubit: tweezer lifetime 6.42(3) s (parametric heating); spin depolarization tens of s, ~100 s with a few G
records.note: T1 here is trap-loss limited, not spin-lattice limited; the spin itself lives far longer.

records.text: 171Yb nuclear-spin qubit in tweezers: spin-echo T2 = 7.9(4) s; Ramsey T2* = 3.7(4) s
records.note: Nuclear spin-1/2 in the ground state - no first-order magnetic sensitivity, hence the long T2*.

records.text: 171Yb nuclear-spin qubit: 170 ns pi/2 pulses (submicrosecond rotations), 5.2(5)e-3 error per Clifford
records.note: Gate error is dominated by the drive, not coherence - 7.9 s / 170 ns is ~5e7 ops per T2.

records.text: No alkaline-earth erasure-qubit QEC round with a published per-round idle/memory error
records.note: Honest null: Yb results are reported per gate (99.72% post-selected CZ) and as erasure fraction.

desc.en: Heralded (SFWM) or quantum-dot photons; entangling is probabilistic (fusion); the error is loss = erasure.
desc.ru: Heralded (SFWM) или квантово-точечные фотоны; перепутывание вероятностное (fusion); ошибка — потеря = erasure.

records.text: PsiQuantum Omega: BTO electro-optic phase shifter insertion loss ~100 mdB (2 mm); SiN waveguide 0.5+/-0.3 dB/m multimode
records.note: Photons have no T1: num is the fraction lost per switch (0.1 dB), unit fraction not seconds.

records.text: No T2 for photons; the analogue is indistinguishability - HOM visibility 99.50(25)%, source spectral purity 99.5(1)%
records.note: Honest null: dephasing has no photonic counterpart; distinguishability plays that role.

records.text: 1Q gates on dual-rail photons are passive phase shifters and beam splitters; no gate duration is stated in the Omega paper
records.note: Honest null: the paper gives component losses and a loss-voltage product, not switching times.

records.text: No photonic QEC round has been demonstrated; a fusion network has no idling syndrome cycle
records.note: Honest null: photonic FT is measurement-driven, so idle error is replaced by delay-line loss.

desc.en: Continuous-variable modes for GKP/cluster states; needs ~10 dB *effective* squeezing for FT (0.62 dB on chip today); raw on-chip squeezing is a different quantity (1.4 dB measured on TFLN).
desc.ru: Моды непрерывных переменных для GKP/кластерных состояний; для FT нужно ~10 дБ *эффективного* сжатия (сегодня 0.62 дБ на чипе); сырое сжатие на чипе — другая величина (1.4 дБ измерено на TFLN).

attrs.en: Xanadu's 0.62 dB is GKP *effective* squeezing, not raw quadrature squeezing — the two are not comparable. The readout coordinate is kept as single-photon detection, but CV practice is homodyne detection.
attrs.ru: 0.62 дБ у Xanadu — *эффективное* сжатие GKP, а не сырое квадратурное; величины несопоставимы. Координата считывания оставлена как детектирование одиночных фотонов, хотя практика CV — гомодинное детектирование.

records.text: Xanadu Aurora: refinery-chip insertion loss 4.15 dB average; heralded optical paths >95% total loss; sources chip 1.82 dB
records.note: CV modes have no T1: num is the fraction lost in one refinery chip (4.15 dB), unit fraction not s.

records.text: No T2 for CV modes; Aurora reports nullifier variances held below vacuum noise over 2 h continuous acquisition
records.note: Honest null: CV dephasing shows up as squeezing degradation (dB), not as a decay time.

records.text: 1Q Gaussian operations are clocked, not pulse-timed; the 1 MHz Aurora cycle is recorded on g_cv
records.note: Null on the carrier by design to avoid duplicating the g_cv t1q record (1 us per cycle).

records.text: No CV QEC round with a published per-round idle error; loss per round is the equivalent quantity and is unstated
records.note: Honest null: Aurora needs a 20-30x (in dB) component-loss improvement before rounds exist.

records.note: Honest null: no two-qubit operation and no Bell test exist for this carrier.

attrs.en: Nord Quantique (microwave), Xanadu (optical). The GKP-qudit work is Brock et al. (UC Santa Barbara + Google, Nature 641, 612), not Yale; Nord Quantique's magic-state SPAM is 8(5)×10⁻³ (7(7)×10⁻⁴ on cardinal states).
attrs.ru: Nord Quantique (СВЧ), Xanadu (оптика). Работа по GKP-кудитам — Brock et al. (UC Santa Barbara + Google, Nature 641, 612), а не Yale; SPAM магических состояний у Nord Quantique — 8(5)×10⁻³ (7(7)×10⁻⁴ на кардинальных состояниях).

desc.en: Encoded spin qubits controlled purely by baseband exchange pulses; leakage 0.015%/Clifford (AEON).
desc.ru: Кодированные спиновые кубиты, управляемые только baseband-импульсами обмена; утечка 0.015%/Клиффорд (AEON).

attrs.en: HRL → IBM.
attrs.ru: HRL → IBM.

desc.en: Photonic dual-rail in time or path; loss is the error and it is heralded.
desc.ru: Фотонный dual-rail во времени или пути; ошибка — потеря, и она heralded.

attrs.en: Origin: Brendel, Gisin, Tittel and Zbinden, Phys. Rev. Lett. 82, 2594 (1999). No mobility of its own — the coordinate is 'none', inherited from the host carrier.
attrs.ru: Происхождение: Brendel, Gisin, Tittel, Zbinden, Phys. Rev. Lett. 82, 2594 (1999). Собственной подвижности нет — координата «—», наследуется от носителя.

desc.en: Qubit in joint parity of two Majorana wires; X-measurement lifetime 1000× shorter than Z in 2025 data.
desc.ru: Кубит в совместной чётности двух майорановских проволок; время жизни X-измерения в 1000 раз короче Z (данные 2025).

defines.value: 12.4 ms / 14.5 µs in the quoted tuning (~9.3 ms / ~4 µs in others; the ~10³ ratio is robust, the point values are not)

attrs.en: The gap is attributed to the larger quasiparticle-capture cross-section of the two-wire X loop — flux noise is not the stated cause. DARPA US2QC: final Validation & Co-Design stage since 2025-02-06, not QBI Stage B.
attrs.ru: Разрыв объясняется большим сечением захвата квазичастиц у двухпроволочной X-петли — потоковый шум как причина в статье не назван. DARPA US2QC: финальная стадия Validation & Co-Design с 2025-02-06, не QBI Stage B.

desc.en: Flux-tunable coupler switches ZZ/exchange on and off; 30–70 ns gates.
desc.ru: Перестраиваемый потоком coupler включает/выключает ZZ/обмен; гейты 30–70 нс.

attrs.en: The often-quoted Oxford '25 ns at 99.8%' is a fixed-coupling coaxmon pair with no tunable coupler and does not belong to this node.
attrs.ru: Часто цитируемое оксфордское «25 нс при 99.8%» — пара coaxmon с фиксированной связью, без перестраиваемого coupler; к этому узлу не относится.

records.text: Willow 105 q QEC chip: two-qubit gate error 0.33% +/- 0.18% (CZ), stated as 'mean, simultaneous' in the spec sheet
records.note: Same sheet gives 1Q 0.035%+/-0.029% and measurement 0.77%+/-0.21%, all mean-simultaneous.

records.text: IBM fleet, Q2 2026: best EPLG 0.19% (ibm_boston); 2,210 qubits across 15 QPUs, best CLOPS 330K+
records.note: EPLG is a chain-based layer-fidelity metric; not numerically interchangeable with a simultaneous-CZ median.

records.text: Google 72-q error budget: CZ crosstalk 5.5e-4 per gate, weight 91, 11% of 1/Lambda - separate from the 2.8e-3 CZ term
records.note: This is the cleanest published simultaneous-minus-isolated split for tunable-coupler CZ.

desc.en: Microwave-only entangling gate on fixed-frequency transmons; 180–500 ns; superseded by tunable couplers in IBM Heron.
desc.ru: Чисто СВЧ гейт на трансмонах фиксированной частоты; 180–500 нс; вытеснен перестраиваемыми couplers в IBM Heron.

defines.metric: CR CNOT with intrinsic static-ZZ suppression (Kandala)

attrs.en: Kandala 2021 suppresses the static ZZ intrinsically (two fixed coupling elements retuning the dressed levels), not by an active cancellation drive; the pulse is 180 ns, not 320 ns. CR stayed IBM's native gate through Condor; Heron introduced the tunable-coupler CZ.
attrs.ru: Kandala 2021 подавляет статический ZZ внутренне (два фиксированных элемента связи перестраивают одетые уровни), а не активным компенсирующим драйвом; импульс 180 нс, не 320 нс. CR оставался нативным гейтом IBM вплоть до Condor; CZ на перестраиваемом coupler появился в Heron.

records.text: ibm_sherbrooke (Eagle r3, 127 q, fixed-coupling CR): EPLG 1.7e-2 at chain length 100 (layer fidelity 0.19); 0.26 at N=80
records.note: Tunable-coupler ibm_montecarlo (Heron, 133 q) on the same benchmark gives 1.2e-2 at N=100.

records.text: No simultaneous-minus-isolated crosstalk figure is published for cross-resonance; Kandala 2021 reports static-ZZ suppression, not a rate
records.note: Honest null: EPLG folds CR crosstalk in but does not separate it.

desc.en: Global Rydberg pulses entangle neighbouring atoms; 270 ns; fast for a natural carrier.
desc.ru: Глобальные ридберговские импульсы перепутывают соседние атомы; 270 нс; быстро для естественного носителя.

records.text: Harvard/Lukin: CZ at 99.5% fidelity on up to 60 atoms entangled in parallel by a global Rydberg pulse
records.note: The Rydberg drive is global, so this is genuinely full-width - no isolated-pair caveat.

records.text: 87Rb CZ 99.854(4)% raw / 99.941(3)% loss-postselected, benchmarked on 8 simultaneous gate sites, stable 10 h
records.note: Up to 20 atoms are moved into the entangling zone; 17 gate sites used, 8 for the benchmark.

records.text: No simultaneous-minus-isolated crosstalk figure is published; with a global Rydberg pulse crosstalk is inside the parallel number
records.note: Honest null: neither the 60-atom nor the 8-site benchmark separates a crosstalk term.

desc.en: Laser-driven spin-motion coupling; 70 µs (Helios) to 550–880 µs (IonQ Forte chains); 1.6 µs record.
desc.ru: Лазерная связь спин–движение; 70 мкс (Helios) — 550–880 мкс (цепочки IonQ Forte); рекорд 1.6 мкс.

defines.metric: IonQ Forte MS duration (30-ion chain, all 435 pairs)
fastest laser gate (Schäfer et al., Oxford)

attrs.en: The 1.6 µs record is Schäfer et al. (Oxford, Nature 555, 2018), not Ballance. The Forte figure is one 30-ion chain benchmarked over all 435 pairs.
attrs.ru: Рекорд 1.6 мкс — Schäfer et al. (Oxford, Nature 555, 2018), а не Ballance. Данные Forte — одна цепочка из 30 ионов, промерены все 435 пар.

records.text: IonQ Forte, 30-ion chain: total duration of each single-qubit Raman gate is 110 us; median 1Q error 2.0e-4
records.note: Laser Raman 1Q gate - the mechanism, not the ion carrier, sets this; compare g_elec at 8 us.

records.text: Quantinuum Helios (98 q): 2QRB infidelity 7.9(2)e-4 averaged over all operational zones; cycle benchmarking 8.1(2)e-4
records.note: QCCD gate zones run concurrently, but this is zone-averaged, not a fixed-lattice full-width layer.

records.text: Quantinuum H2 datasheet: crosstalk error typical 1e-5, range 1e-6 to 2e-4
records.note: Spatial isolation of QCCD zones is why ion crosstalk is 1-2 orders below superconducting.

nodes.ru: Электронный near-field СВЧ гейт (ионы, без лазера)

desc.en: Chip currents create microwave gradients; no lasers for gates, no ground-state cooling; 120–226 µs.
desc.ru: Токи на чипе создают СВЧ-градиенты; без лазеров для гейтов, без охлаждения в основное состояние; 120–226 мкс.

attrs.en: Oxford Ionics → IonQ.
attrs.ru: Oxford Ionics → IonQ.

records.text: Oxford Ionics near-field microwave 1Q gate: 8 us total (7.5 us coherent + 0.5 us dead), 8.4(7)e-6 error per Clifford
records.note: Laser-free: 14x faster than the IonQ Forte Raman 1Q gate and ~25x lower error.

records.text: The 8.4(7)e-5 smooth gate and the 3(1)e-4 / 4.7(7)e-4 12 h and 60 h figures are two-ion measurements, not full-width parallel
records.note: Honest null: no multi-zone simultaneous 2Q benchmark has been published for this mechanism.

records.text: Oxford Ionics: residual interaction with hidden spectator qubits 1.6(8)e-6 per Clifford; between zones <= ~1e-6
records.note: Lowest published crosstalk of any entangling mechanism in the Map; qubits are hidden by shifting.

nodes.ru: Обменный гейт (спины; вкл. CZ на переносимых спинах)

desc.en: Voltage-pulsed exchange J (10–90 MHz); 58–500 ns; ~80% of error is calibration/control (HRL).
desc.ru: Обмен J (10–90 МГц) под импульсами напряжения; 58–500 нс; ~80% ошибки — калибровка/управление (HRL).

attrs.en: Best exchange gate is HRL's exchange-only CNOT at 9×10⁻⁴; SQC (Nature 2025): nuclear CZ 99.90(4)%, 1Q 99.10–99.99%, Bell 91.4–99.5% local and 87.0–97.0% non-local — no Bell > 99%.
attrs.ru: Лучший обменный гейт — exchange-only CNOT у HRL, 9×10⁻⁴; SQC (Nature 2025): ядерный CZ 99.90(4)%, 1Q 99.10–99.99%, Bell 91.4–99.5% локально и 87.0–97.0% нелокально — никакого Bell > 99%.

records.text: The 99.04-99.56% 300 mm CZ fidelities are isolated two-qubit RB; no simultaneous or full-width spin-qubit measurement exists
records.note: Honest null: largest exchange-coupled arrays are 18 qubits, and are benchmarked pairwise.

records.text: Not reported: the 300 mm paper gives only Stark-shift coefficients (e.g. 31.3(3) MHz/V/T on the J gate), not a crosstalk error
records.note: Honest null: electrostatic crosstalk in dense dot arrays is cited as a known issue, not quantified.

desc.en: Probabilistic Bell measurement on photons (50%, 75% boosted); failure is heralded → erasure.
desc.ru: Вероятностное измерение Белла на фотонах (50%, 75% с усилением); неудача heralded → erasure.

records.text: Fusion Bell-state fidelity 99.22(12)% is a single-fusion measurement; no parallel or network-scale fusion figure is published
records.note: Honest null. Related Omega numbers: SPAM 99.98(1)%, chip-to-chip interconnect 99.72(4)%.

records.text: No crosstalk figure: fusion failure is heralded and enters the loss budget, not a coherent-error budget
records.note: Honest null by construction - linear optics has no static coupling between qubits to leak.

nodes.en: Ancilla-mediated bosonic gates (cat CX, dual-rail CZ, beam-splitter)
nodes.ru: Бозонные гейты через анциллу (cat CX, dual-rail CZ, beam-splitter)

desc.en: Transmon ancilla, or a differentially driven DC-SQUID beam-splitter coupler between modes; ~500 ns.
desc.ru: Анцилла-трансмон либо beam-splitter-coupler на дифференциально управляемом DC-SQUID между модами; ~500 нс.

attrs.en: The beam-splitter coupler of arXiv:2303.00959 is a differentially driven DC-SQUID, not a SNAIL. Quantum Circuits was never in DARPA QBI; Alice & Bob reached Stage A only.
attrs.ru: Beam-splitter-coupler в arXiv:2303.00959 — дифференциально управляемый DC-SQUID, а не SNAIL. Quantum Circuits никогда не входила в DARPA QBI; Alice & Bob дошла только до Stage A.

records.text: Yale dual-rail cavity qubit: beam-splitter single-qubit gate ~200 ns, post-selected RB error ~0.01%, erasure ~0.1%
records.note: The mechanism defines the 1Q gate for the cavity carrier, so it is recorded here, not on cavity.

records.text: Dual-rail CZ 0.029(6)% post-selected (0.53(2)% erasure per CZ, Pauli <0.1%) is a two-qubit measurement, not a parallel one
records.note: Honest null: no multi-pair simultaneous operation of ancilla-mediated bosonic gates is published.

records.text: No crosstalk figure published for ancilla-mediated bosonic gates or for the DC-SQUID beam-splitter coupler
records.note: Honest null: SPAM ~0.02% and bit-flip errors at the 1e-6 level are given, but no crosstalk term.

desc.en: Braiding by sequences of parity measurements — nothing demonstrated; single-wire readout only.
desc.ru: Плетение последовательностями измерений чётности — ничего не продемонстрировано; только считывание одной проволоки.

records.text: No two-qubit Majorana operation exists, in parallel or otherwise; only single-wire parity readout has been demonstrated
records.note: Honest null: nothing to measure - no braiding, no entanglement, no Bell test.

records.text: No measurement-based Majorana gate has been demonstrated, so no crosstalk figure can exist
records.note: Honest null by construction.

desc.en: Coherent quenches 3.6–27 ns on 1,222–5,627 qubits; not a gate.
desc.ru: Когерентные квенчи 3.6–27 нс на 1 222–5 627 кубитах; не гейт.

attrs.en: Pasqal's 10,000 physical qubits slipped from 2026 to 2028 (100 logical in 2029); QuEra's Series B expansion closed 2025-09-09 (Google, SoftBank Vision Fund 2, NVentures); Quantinuum's magnetism result is Trotterised *digital* simulation, not analog evolution.
attrs.ru: 10 000 физических кубитов Pasqal сдвинуты с 2026 на 2028 (100 логических — 2029); расширение Series B у QuEra закрыто 2025-09-09 (Google, SoftBank Vision Fund 2, NVentures); результат Quantinuum по магнетизму — троттеризованная *цифровая* симуляция, а не аналоговая эволюция.

records.text: Annealing evolution is not a gate; no two-qubit error rate is defined or published for D-Wave hardware
records.note: Honest null by construction: performance is quoted as anneal time and solution quality.

records.text: D-Wave ICE: delta-J std ~0.0095-0.0155 and delta-h std ~0.010-0.026 through the anneal; background susceptibility chi -0.04 to -0.015
records.note: num is the geometric mean of the delta-J spread. Vendor docs, D-Wave 2X-era representative values.

desc.en: Heavy-hex (degree 2.3) or square lattice (degree 3.5–3.6) with on-chip couplers; ZZ crosstalk is the tax.
desc.ru: Heavy-hex (степень 2.3) или квадратная решётка (степень 3.5–3.6) с couplers на чипе; налог — ZZ-crosstalk.

defines.metric: CZ crosstalk (fitted budget term, Willow d=7)

attrs.en: The 5.5×10⁻⁴ is a fitted component of the Willow error budget, not a directly measured crosstalk figure. EUV is a single point of failure for the spin branch only — no fielded transmon lattice uses it. Rigetti: median 2Q 99.5% at 36 q falls to 99.1% at 108 q (12 chiplets).
attrs.ru: 5.5×10⁻⁴ — подобранная компонента бюджета ошибок Willow, а не напрямую измеренный crosstalk. EUV — единая точка отказа только для спиновой ветви: ни одна работающая трансмонная решётка её не использует. Rigetti: медиана 2Q 99.5% при 36 q падает до 99.1% при 108 q (12 чиплетов).

records.text: IBM Nighthawk: '120 qubits linked together with 218 next-generation tunable couplers' in a square lattice -> mean degree 2x218/120 = 3.63
records.note: Bulk degree is 4; the mean is cut by the boundary. IBM heavy-hex runs ~2.3; no Willow coupler count is published.

records.text: Zero by construction: a static coupler lattice moves no qubits; the whole 1.1 us Willow / 921 ns Sycamore cycle is gates, measure, reset
records.note: Recorded as 0 rather than null so space-time derivations can compare against mobile platforms.

desc.en: Resonator/coupler links beyond NN; enables degree-6 qLDPC layouts; 2 mm CZ 99.81% (IQM); IBM Loon components without numbers.
desc.ru: Резонаторные/coupler-связи дальше NN; открывает qLDPC-разводки степени 6; CZ на 2 мм 99.81% (IQM); компоненты IBM Loon без чисел.

defines.value: c-couplers + multilayer routing shown, no performance numbers

records.text: Design target, not a measured device: gross-code layouts need 'a degree-6 graph that consists of two edge-disjoint planar subgraphs'
records.note: IBM Loon demonstrates c-couplers and routing layers but publishes no mean degree or coupler count.

records.text: Zero: c-couplers and mm-scale resonator links are static wiring, not transport; the gross-code cycle is 7 CNOT layers with no move step
records.note: Recorded as 0 so long-range on-chip layouts compare against QCCD/AOD transport budgets.

desc.en: Ions moved between zones at m/s with sub-quantum heating; transport + cooling dominate runtime (55 ms per full layer on Helios).
desc.ru: Ионы перемещаются между зонами со скоростью м/с при нагреве меньше кванта; транспорт + охлаждение доминируют во времени (55 мс на полный слой Helios).

attrs.en: A chip-to-chip matter link between two ion-trap modules exists (Universal Quantum, Nat. Commun. 14, 531, 2023); the empty slot here is a link across more than two modules, not chip-to-chip itself.
attrs.ru: Межчиповый материальный линк между двумя модулями ионных ловушек существует (Universal Quantum, Nat. Commun. 14, 531, 2023); пустой слот здесь — связь более чем двух модулей, а не сама стыковка чип-чип.

records.text: Helios: 98-qubit ion processor with 'all-to-all connectivity enabled by a rotatable ion storage ring' joining two operation regions
records.note: Effective degree N-1 = 97: any pair can be co-located, at the cost of transport time, not couplers.

records.text: Helios: 'an average of 55 ms per layer' for a full-width depth-1 layer (transport + ground-state cooling + gates); 2Q gate itself is ~70 us
records.note: Transport and cooling dominate: an extra ~300 us of cooling follows each 2Q gate. 8 operation zones.

records.text: H1 QCCD primitives: interzone shift 283 us, intrazone shift 58 us, split/combine 128 us, swap 200 us; sideband cooling 850 us and 650 us
records.note: num = 283 us interzone shift + 850 us axial/radial SB cooling; the table lists primitives, not a per-layer sum.

records.text: Full-width upper bound: transport is '60% on average' of H2 circuit time; on Helios's 55 ms 98-qubit layer that is ~33 ms of transport
records.note: Scales with width: a small QEC circuit sorts far fewer ions. Helios adds ~300 us cooling after each 2Q gate.

nodes.ru: Шина мод движения ионной цепочки (all-to-all в цепочке)

desc.en: Shared motional modes give all-to-all within one chain; gates slow with chain length (median 672 µs on Forte's 30-ion chain).
desc.ru: Общие моды движения дают all-to-all внутри одной цепочки; гейты замедляются с её длиной (медиана 672 мкс на 30-ионной цепочке Forte).

defines.value: 100 ions, #AQ 64 [C] — a company claim, no per-pair data

attrs.en: IonQ Forte is a 30-ion chain (435 pairs), not 36; the 100-ion all-to-all Tempo chain is a company claim with no published gate time or per-pair fidelity.
attrs.ru: IonQ Forte — цепочка из 30 ионов (435 пар), а не 36; 100-ионная цепочка Tempo с all-to-all — заявление компании без опубликованного времени гейта и попарных fidelity.

records.text: IonQ Forte: 'single-chain 30-qubit trapped-ion quantum computer with all-to-all operations', benchmarked over all 30-choose-2 = 435 pairs
records.note: Degree N-1 = 29 via shared motional modes; the claimed 100-ion Tempo chain has no published per-pair data.

records.text: Not applicable: a single motional-bus chain performs no transport between zones; all 435 Forte pairs are addressed in place
records.note: Honest null. Ion transport time belongs to cx_qccd (55 ms per full-width Helios layer).

nodes.en: Atom transport by AOD tweezers (zoned architecture)

desc.en: Coherence-preserving moves of 100s µm in 0.4–1.6 ms at ~99.95%; storage/entangling/readout zones.
desc.ru: Сохраняющие когерентность перемещения на сотни мкм за 0.4–1.6 мс при ~99.95%; зоны хранения/перепутывания/считывания.

defines.value: 610 µm in 1.6 ms at 99.95%; 270 µm in 400 µs at 99.8%

attrs.en: Harvard's continuously reloaded 3,000-atom system moves atoms ~0.5 m on optical-lattice conveyor belts, using AOD tweezers only for local rearrangement. TU/e's 3D acousto-optic lensing (arXiv:2510.09398) is a design study [S] with no atoms.
attrs.ru: Непрерывно перезагружаемая система Harvard на 3 000 атомов перемещает атомы на ~0.5 м оптическими решёточными конвейерами, а AOD-пинцеты использует только для локальной перестановки. 3D acousto-optic lensing из TU/e (arXiv:2510.09398) — расчётная работа [S], без атомов.

records.text: 448-atom zoned processor: 'atoms are rearranged with the AOD traps to enable arbitrary connectivity': all-to-all, degree N-1
records.note: Reachability degree, not simultaneity: each atom still takes one partner per entangling layer (256 in the zone).

records.text: Caltech 6,100-atom array: 'atoms transported by 610 um in 1.6 ms' with ~99.95% fidelity; 270 um moves take 0.35-1 ms at 99.85-99.94%
records.note: num is one inter-zone move; the number of moves per syndrome round is not published for any atom QEC run.

records.text: Harvard/QuEra logical processor: 'characteristic free-space movement time between gates is roughly 200 us'; SLM-AOD transfer adds 150-300 us
records.note: Transport between two consecutive gate layers; long inter-zone hops cost more (Caltech 270 um in 0.35-1 ms).

desc.en: Spins carried 10 µm in < 200 ns at 99.5%; gates between moving spins 98.86%; gives fabricated carriers transport connectivity.
desc.ru: Спины переносятся на 10 мкм за < 200 нс при 99.5%; гейты между движущимися спинами 98.86%; даёт изготовленным носителям транспортную связность.

records.text: Ge/Si array: one mobile shuttled ancilla reaches the 4 data qubits of a weight-four parity check; no mean coupler degree is published
records.note: Degree here is the ancilla's reach per round, not a static coupler count; the array is a 5-qubit processor.

records.text: Ge/Si spin array: 'the shortest weight-four parity-check circuit has a duration of 4.84 us'; 1.2 um round-trip shuttle path at 1.8 m/s
records.note: Shuttle fidelity 97.7(1)% per identity operation; the 10 us PSB readout, not transport, sets the real cycle.

records.text: Ge/Si spin bus: '1.2-um round-trip shuttling path' at 'a speed of 1.8 m s-1' = ~670 ns per round trip; a DCZ 'uses two rounds of shuttling'
records.note: num derived from the stated path and speed; no explicit per-shuttle duration is given. Whole weight-4 circuit: 4.84 us.

desc.en: Every switch costs loss: 0.19 dB/MZI at system scale (Aurora), 100 mdB for the best in-line element (PsiQuantum BTO); FT needs ~7 mdB.
desc.ru: Каждый переключатель стоит потерь: 0.19 дБ/MZI в масштабе системы (Aurora), 100 мдБ у лучшего элемента в линии (BTO у PsiQuantum); для FT нужно ~7 мдБ.

attrs.en: A '30 mdB' switch figure sometimes quoted is untraceable to any source. Omega's single-mode SiN loss is 1.8(2) dB/m against the 0.5 dB/m multimode figure — unreconciled.
attrs.ru: Иногда цитируемые «30 мдБ» для переключателя не прослеживаются ни к одному источнику. Потери одномодового SiN в Omega — 1.8(2) дБ/м против многомодовых 0.5 дБ/м; расхождение не устранено.

records.text: Undefined for a switch fabric: connectivity is reprogrammed each clock cycle, and no mean degree is published for Omega or Aurora
records.note: Honest null. The meaningful cost is loss per switch: 100 mdB in-line (BTO), 0.19 dB/MZI at system scale.

records.text: No transport and no syndrome round: photons propagate at c through the switch network and are consumed by fusion, not idled between rounds
records.note: Honest null. Feed-forward latency (1 us single-clock-cycle on Aurora) is recorded on the control layer.

desc.en: Shared plunger/barrier lines: 23 lines for 16 dots, T = 6√g − 1 scaling; no coherent qubit operation shown.
desc.ru: Общие plunger/barrier-линии: 23 линии на 16 точек, масштабирование T = 6√g − 1; когерентных операций с кубитами не показано.

defines.metric: control lines vs dots (no coherent qubit operation)

attrs.en: The 2024 crossbar (16 dots, 23 lines; founding paper online 2023-08-28) showed no coherent qubit operation. The 'one of four pairs gated' result belongs to imec/Diraq's individually wired 8-qubit 300 mm device (Nat. Commun. 17, 5878, 2026-07), not to a crossbar.
attrs.ru: Crossbar 2024 года (16 точек, 23 линии; основополагающая статья онлайн 2023-08-28) не показал когерентных операций с кубитами. Результат «сработала одна пара из четырёх» относится к индивидуально разведённому 8-кубитному 300-мм устройству imec/Diraq (Nat. Commun. 17, 5878, 2026-07), а не к crossbar.

records.text: Ge crossbar: 'two-dimensional 16-quantum-dot system' on a 4x4 grid with 23 gates; 24 nearest-neighbour bonds / 16 dots gives mean degree 3.0
records.note: num derived from the stated 4x4 geometry; 'an individual barrier [controls] up to six nearest-neighbour interactions'.

records.text: No syndrome round: the crossbar showed charge control only (tunnel coupling 3-20 GHz), no coherent qubit operation and no shuttling schedule
records.note: Honest null: without coherent operation there is no round to time.

desc.en: One RF line per qubit through the fridge; the I/O wall: > 4,000 RF lines (KIDE), 1,121 qubits (Condor).
desc.ru: Одна РЧ-линия на кубит через криостат; стена I/O: > 4 000 РЧ-линий (KIDE), 1 121 кубит (Condor).

records.text: Google Willow d=5: 'average decoder latency of 63 us ... with a cycle time of 1.1 us'; Fig. 4c gives 63 +/- 17 us
records.note: Final-syndrome-received to correction-returned; 57x the QEC cycle.

records.text: Rigetti Ankaa-2 + FPGA decoder: '9.6 us' total response over 9 rounds = 6.5 us decoding + 3.1 us communication and control
records.note: 2x2 stability patch, 1.7 us QEC round; closest published end-to-end measurement-to-conditioned-op figure.

records.text: Bluefors KIDE: 'over 4 000 RF lines' and 'supports more than 1000 qubits', i.e. ~4 RF lines per qubit at rated capacity
records.note: Undated vendor page, accessed 2026-09; a platform capacity, not a count measured on a processor.

records.text: VTT/IQM superconducting QPUs are calibrated 'twice a day at 00:45 UTC and 14:15 UTC' (frequency, amplitude, readout, CZ, RB)
records.note: Undated operator page, accessed 2026-09; Google states only 'between every four experimental runs'.

desc.en: CMOS ASICs at 4 K (or 7 mK) generating pulses next to the qubits; 2–23 mW/qubit at 4 K; 20 nW/MHz per cell at mK.
desc.ru: CMOS ASIC при 4 K (или 7 мК), формирующие импульсы рядом с кубитами; 2–23 мВт/кубит при 4 K; 20 нВт/МГц на ячейку при мК.

defines.value: ≤ 3.5 W, 366 DACs; d=5 *bit-flip-only* repetition code Λ=4.7 without room-temperature real-time electronics (arXiv Apr–May 2026, Nature Jul 2026)

defines.metric: mK CMOS next to spin qubits

records.text: No feed-forward latency stated: HRL's d=5 repetition code ran from the on-chip sequencer without room-temperature real-time electronics
records.note: Honest null: a custom instruction set is described, but no measurement-to-gate latency.

records.text: HRL 4 K cryo-CMOS: '156 output channels, 366 DACs' driving '54 exchange-coupled quantum dots, configurable to host up to 18 EO qubits'
records.note: 156/18 = 8.7 cryo channels per qubit (20 DACs/qubit); the RT link carries only digital, readout, bias.

records.text: No recalibration interval or drift figure is given for the 4 K controller
records.note: Honest null.

desc.en: Single-flux-quantum digital circuits at the mK stage: pulse trains drive qubits from a flip-chip (1Q > 99%, 99.9% peak; nW/qubit claimed), and the same circuit family loads D-Wave's on-chip flux DACs. SFQ logic at 4 K (pulse sequencing, decoding) is the empty cold-decoder slot, not a control node.
desc.ru: Одноквантовые цифровые схемы на мК-ступени: цепочки импульсов управляют кубитами с flip-chip (1Q > 99%, пик 99.9%; заявлено нВт/кубит), и та же схемотехника загружает on-chip flux-DAC D-Wave. SFQ-логика при 4 K (секвенсирование импульсов, декодирование) — пустой слот холодного декодера, а не узел управления.

attrs.en: SEEQC–IBM integration under DARPA QBI (since Jun 2025).
attrs.ru: Интеграция SEEQC–IBM в рамках DARPA QBI (с июня 2025).

records.text: SEEQC mK SFQ uses 'digital demultiplexing to distribute control pulses to several qubits, thus breaking the linear scaling'
records.note: Honest null: the demux factor is asserted qualitatively; the quantitative claim is 1Q >99%, up to 99.9%.

desc.en: Annealer-heritage SFQ flux DACs: ~200–300 bias lines for 10⁴ qubits; applied to fluxonium (bump-bonded MCM).
desc.ru: Flux-DAC на SFQ из наследия отжигателей: ~200–300 линий смещения на 10⁴ кубитов; применено к флаксониуму (bump-bonded MCM).

defines.value: ~300 bias lines into the QPU, of which ~200 multiplexed lines address ~10⁵ on-chip DACs (whitepaper 2026-01-23); fluxonium MCM at 10 mK

attrs.en: The 200 and 300 in D-Wave's texts count different line sets: ~300 bias lines in total, ~200 multiplexed lines addressing the DAC network (both in the 2026-01-23 whitepaper). NASA JPL fabricated key components of the module.
attrs.ru: 200 и 300 в текстах D-Wave считают разные наборы линий: ~300 линий смещения всего, ~200 мультиплексированных линий адресуют сеть DAC (обе цифры в whitepaper 2026-01-23). Ключевые компоненты модуля изготовлены в NASA JPL.

records.text: D-Wave 512 q: '512 single-, 3520 two- and 512 three-stage flux-DACs are controlled with an XYZ addressing scheme requiring 56 wires'
records.note: 56/512 = 0.109 wires per qubit for 4,544 on-chip DACs; current gen ~300 lines for 'several thousand' qubits.

desc.en: SLM-generated tweezer arrays (12,000 sites), AOD moves, Rydberg lasers; 33 W for 18,225 tweezers; the binding constraint above 10⁴ sites is the AOD time–bandwidth product, not an SLM refresh rate.
desc.ru: Массивы пинцетов от SLM (12 000 сайтов), перемещения AOD, ридберговские лазеры; 33 Вт на 18 225 пинцетов; выше 10⁴ сайтов ограничивает произведение время–полоса у AOD, а не частота обновления SLM.

attrs.en: The '~10 MHz SLM refresh' sometimes quoted is unsourced: LCOS panels frame at tens of hertz, and deflector reconfiguration is bounded by acoustic transit. The only end-to-end vendor loop figure is QuEra Gemini: one shot per second at 260 qubits.
attrs.ru: Иногда цитируемое «обновление SLM ~10 МГц» не подкреплено источником: панели LCOS обновляются с частотой десятков герц, а перестройка дефлектора ограничена акустическим пробегом. Единственная сквозная вендорская цифра — QuEra Gemini: один выстрел в секунду на 260 кубитах.

records.text: 87Rb cavity MCM: 'a 5 us wait time after each 40 us detection window is used to process measurement information'
records.note: 45 us measure-and-feedforward cycle; the 448-atom logical run applied feed-forward in software only.

records.text: Global optics: 'a global Raman path illuminating the entire array is used for global rotations'; traps come from one SLM plus crossed AODs
records.note: Honest null: channels scale with AOD tones (rows+columns), not atom number; no per-atom figure published.

records.text: No recalibration interval published; the paper only notes 'Rabi calibrations with a 4-ms cycle time'
records.note: Honest null: a cycle rate, not a cadence.

nodes.en: PIC-generated tweezers / integrated optics for atoms
nodes.ru: Пинцеты от PIC / интегрированная оптика для атомов

desc.en: Trap generation moved onto a photonic chip (4 atoms, 27.5 s lifetimes); fabricated-world optics for a natural carrier.
desc.ru: Генерация ловушек перенесена на фотонный чип (4 атома, время жизни 27.5 с); оптика изготовленного мира для естественного носителя.

attrs.en: Pasqal. Two functions hide here and only the first is trap generation: UChicago's 2024 tweezers are free-space traps over nanophotonic cavities, and USTC's 2026 glass-waveguide chip addresses trapped atoms rather than generating the traps.
attrs.ru: Pasqal. Здесь скрыты две функции, и только первая — генерация ловушек: пинцеты UChicago 2024 года — ловушки в свободном пространстве над нанофотонными резонаторами, а стеклянно-волноводный чип USTC 2026 года адресует уже захваченные атомы, а не создаёт ловушки.

records.text: Pasqal on-chip tweezers: 'four optical traps through a single photonic chip ... to hold four individual rubidium atoms', ~27.5 s lifetimes
records.note: One waveguide-fed trap per atom; no multiplexing shown and no control-architecture detail given.

desc.en: Waveguides in the trap deliver all wavelengths; > 99.3% 2Q (ETH); ≥ 7 wavelengths on Helios.
desc.ru: Волноводы в ловушке доставляют все длины волн; > 99.3% 2Q (ETH); ≥ 7 длин волн на Helios.

records.text: Quantinuum Helios: 'magnetic field calibrations (every ~5 s)'; field drift ~200 uG over 24 h
records.note: Fastest published recalibration cadence in this layer; H2's data sheet says only 'predetermined intervals'.

records.text: No measurement-to-conditioned-operation latency is published for H2/Helios mid-circuit conditional operations
records.note: Honest null; timing is dominated by ~70 us 2Q gates and ~300 us post-transport cooling.

desc.en: Electronic signal sources replace gate lasers: ~200 sources for 1,000 ions (WISE); 1Q 1.5×10⁻⁷ without shielding.
desc.ru: Электронные источники сигнала заменяют лазеры гейтов: ~200 источников на 1 000 ионов (WISE); 1Q 1.5×10⁻⁷ без экранирования.

attrs.en: Oxford Ionics/IonQ, eleQtron (MAGIC).
attrs.ru: Oxford Ionics/IonQ, eleQtron (MAGIC).

records.text: WISE: 'operate a fully connected 1000-qubit trapped ion quantum computer using ~200 signal sources' (integrated switching)
records.note: Design study, not a built machine; matches the node's defines record, now numeric.

desc.en: Voltage pulses on gates; digital, dense; the calibration burden shows up as coherent error.
desc.ru: Импульсы напряжения на затворах; цифровое, плотное; бремя калибровки проявляется как когерентная ошибка.

defines.metric: extrinsic control share of CNOT error

attrs.en: QuTech's baseband hopping-gate figure of 99.50(6)% is a lower bound, not a point estimate. HRL's Λ = 4.7 is a bit-flip-only repetition code, and its [[4,2,2]] fidelity of 0.95 is post-selected.
attrs.ru: 99.50(6)% для baseband hopping-гейта у QuTech — нижняя граница, а не точечная оценка. Λ = 4.7 у HRL — repetition-код только по bit-flip, а его [[4,2,2]] с fidelity 0.95 — постселектированный.

records.text: Si quantum-dot crossbar: 'combined control reduces the total number of gate lines to N_wires ~ 4*sqrt(2N)+1' - ~180 lines for 1,000 qubits
records.note: Design scaling only; the best measured baseband device (HRL) sits at 8.7 channels per qubit.

records.text: Real-time feedback tracks the SET operating point and Larmor/Rabi frequencies, but no latency is quoted
records.note: Honest null: that is calibration feedback, not measurement-conditioned gating.

records.text: 'The consistent calibration of qubits at the level demonstrated here remains an intensive manual process' - no interval given
records.note: Honest null; the qualitative statement is itself the state of the art for spin qubits.

desc.en: Resonator shift read through a parametric amplifier; 240 ns pulse at 99.94% (IQM); readout-induced leakage is the hidden cost.
desc.ru: Сдвиг резонатора, читаемый через параметрический усилитель; импульс 240 нс при 99.94% (IQM); скрытая цена — утечка, наведённая считыванием.

defines.value: 240 ns pulse (≈280 ns full window) / 99.94% simultaneous assignment; QNDness 99.3%

records.text: Google surface code: 'Cycle duration is 921 ns, including 500 ns measurement and 160 ns reset' (measure-qubit multi-level reset)
records.note: Willow's 1.1 us cycle is never broken down in 2408.13687; same multi-level reset + DQLR family.

records.text: IBM Nighthawk r2: activating the reset coupler pulls effective T1 from ~200 us median 'down to roughly 25 nanoseconds'
records.note: 25 ns is the effective T1 during the pulse, not a measured reset duration; no reset error published.

records.text: Unconditional all-microwave reset via |f0>-|g1> transfer to the resonator: <500 ns, 0.2% residual excitation
records.note: Single-qubit ETH demo; Google and IBM publish no separate reset error for their processors.

records.text: Willow 105-q QEC chip: measurement error 0.77% +/- 0.21% (repetitive, measure qubits); RCS chip 0.67% +/- 0.51% (terminal)
records.note: Repetitive measurement error folds in reset; no separate state-preparation error is given.

records.text: IQM, 240 ns readout pulse with |f>-shelving + TWPA: simultaneous assignment fidelity 'above 99.94%' for both qubits
records.note: Two-qubit test device, one resonator plus individual Purcell filter per qubit (chi/kappa ~ 0.5).

records.text: IQM: 'QNDness 99.3% for both qubits', measured without the shelving gate
records.note: Matches the node's existing defines record; converted to a numeric fraction.

desc.en: State-dependent scattering counted by PMT/SNSPD; 11 µs at 99.93% record; SPAM 4.8×10⁻⁴ on Helios.
desc.ru: Зависимое от состояния рассеяние, считаемое ФЭУ/SNSPD; рекорд 11 мкс при 99.93%; SPAM 4.8×10⁻⁴ на Helios.

attrs.en: The Kyoto/Yaqumo 17.6 µs result (arXiv:2605.24175) is neutral ¹⁷⁴Yb *imaging* — spinless, not qubit-state-resolved — and is not an ion-readout record.
attrs.ru: Результат Kyoto/Yaqumo 17.6 мкс (arXiv:2605.24175) — *imaging* нейтрального ¹⁷⁴Yb, бесспиновый и не разрешающий состояние кубита; это не рекорд считывания ионов.

records.text: 137Ba+: 'Population initialization is performed by turning on pi-polarized 493 nm light ... for 20 us' (optical pumping)
records.note: H2/Helios publish no optical-pumping duration; Helios adds ~3 ms ground-state cooling per block.

records.text: No separate initialisation/reset error is published for H2 or Helios; both quote a combined SPAM figure only
records.note: Honest null: Helios reports SPAM 4.8(6)e-4 as one number, not split into prep and measure.

records.text: Quantinuum Helios: 'average infidelities of ... 4.8(6) x 10-4 for state preparation and measurement'
records.note: H2 data sheet: typical 1.5e-3 (1e-3 to 5e-3); H2 racetrack paper measured 1.6(1)e-3.

records.text: 137Ba+ heralded SPAM: 7(4)e-6 optical qubit, 5(4)e-6 metastable, 8(4)e-6 ground-level; 400 us camera exposure
records.note: Heralded and post-selected on QND population checks; one ion, not a processor-wide figure.

records.text: No QND fidelity or measurement-survival number is quoted for H2/Helios ion readout
records.note: Detection is QND for the surviving ion by construction; only leakage/crosstalk are quantified.

desc.en: Camera imaging, 0.5–1 ms typical; non-destructive with 0.24% loss; fast neutral-Yb imaging emerging (17.6 µs, 99.89%).
desc.ru: Imaging камерой, типично 0.5–1 мс; неразрушающее с потерей 0.24%; формируется быстрый imaging нейтрального Yb (17.6 мкс, 99.89%).

defines.value: 17.6 µs, 99.89% discrimination, 98.8% survival — neutral ¹⁷⁴Yb, spinless (not qubit-state-resolved)

records.text: Atom Computing: atom reload cycle '~90 ms, which includes the software processing time and a sequence buffer time of ~20 ms'
records.note: MOT + transport (~60 ms) runs in parallel with syndrome extraction; range 30-90 ms.

records.text: Continuous 3,000-atom system: an array segment is ejected and refilled 'every ~80 ms'; 300,000 atoms/s trapped, 30,000 qubits/s initialised
records.note: Sustained >2 h of continuous operation; 15,000 qubits/s once rearrangement is included.

records.text: Atom Computing: mid-circuit-measurement reset loss 9.5(4.6)e-3 per MCM cycle; initial load loss 6.8(6.8)e-3
records.note: Reset means reloading a replacement atom, so the error is a loss probability, not a population residual.

records.text: Harvard/QuEra 448-atom: '0.46(4)% bit-flip error and 0.24(2)% loss' per non-destructive spin-to-position readout
records.note: The 0.24% loss is an extra erasure term; Atom Computing quotes <2.0(0.4)e-3 per image.

records.text: Harvard/QuEra 448-atom: non-destructive readout with 0.24(2)% atom loss, i.e. 99.76% survival per mid-circuit image
records.note: The continuous 3,000-atom system reports a comparable 99.5% imaging survival.

desc.en: Pauli/energy-selective tunnelling sensed by a gate-based single-electron box (SEB) or an SET; 99.2% in < 6 µs; 99.9% at 100 µs.
desc.ru: Туннелирование по Паули/энергии, регистрируемое затворным одноэлектронным боксом (SEB) или SET; 99.2% за < 6 мкс; 99.9% за 100 мкс.

defines.metric: fast readout (Oakes et al., Quantum Motion; rf single-electron box)

attrs.en: The 99.2% in < 6 µs is Oakes et al., PRX 13, 011023 (2023), Quantum Motion — an rf single-electron box, not an SET.
attrs.ru: 99.2% за < 6 мкс — Oakes et al., PRX 13, 011023 (2023), Quantum Motion: rf-одноэлектронный бокс, а не SET.

records.text: Si spins: 'heralded initialization protocol ... repeated the initialization if unsuccessful', with a t_ramp = 1 us ramp at V_J = 1.12 V
records.note: 1 us is the deterministic ramp; each herald costs a 100 us SET integration, so init is readout-limited.

records.text: Initialisation error is not reported separately from the 99.9% SPAM figure
records.note: Heralding discards failed initialisations, so a bare init error is not defined for this protocol.

records.text: Si spins, Pauli spin blockade + d.c. single-island SET: 'SPAM fidelities reach up to 99.9%' at t_int = 100 us; best device 99.95(8)%
records.note: 3 of 4 devices exceed 99.9%; the fast reference (Oakes, 99.2% in <6 us) trades 10x fidelity for 17x speed.

records.text: No QND or repeated-readout fidelity is reported for the PSB/SET spin readout
records.note: Spin-to-charge conversion destroys the spin state on a singlet outcome, so QND is not claimed.

desc.en: Destructive by nature; 93.4% wafer-scale median to 99.73% on a hero device, 3 ps jitter, 1–4 K; thousands of channels needed.
desc.ru: Разрушающее по природе; от 93.4% медианы в масштабе пластины до 99.73% на рекордном устройстве, джиттер 3 пс, 1–4 K; нужны тысячи каналов.

defines.metric: wafer-scale median on-chip efficiency (PsiQuantum Omega, 300 mm)

attrs.en: The '98.9% median (PsiQuantum)' sometimes quoted is superseded: the Omega paper gives 93.4% median on-chip efficiency — 0.30 dB per detection rather than 0.05 dB.
attrs.ru: Иногда цитируемая «98.9% медиана (PsiQuantum)» вытеснена: статья по Omega даёт 93.4% медианной эффективности на чипе — 0.30 дБ на детектирование вместо 0.05 дБ.

records.text: SNSPD dead time, not a qubit reset: 'recovery time tau_rec,exp is suppressed from 20.3 ns at Ih = 0 uA to 7.1 ns'; 120 Mcps
records.note: Photon detectors have no reset step; the analogue is dead time / recovery (20.3 ns nominal, 7.1 ns tuned).

records.text: Not defined for a photon detector; the analogue is latching/afterpulsing, unquantified in the Omega paper
records.note: Honest null.

records.text: PsiQuantum Omega 300 mm: SNSPD 'median on-chip efficiency of 93.4% and average value of 88.9% +/- 3.5%'; PNRDs 98.9% median
records.note: SPAM analogue for a destructive detector = 1 - detection efficiency (6.6% at the wafer median).

records.text: QND survival is undefined: SNSPD/TES detection absorbs the photon (the node's own coordinate marks it destructive)
records.note: Honest null; a photon-number-resolving TES is equally destructive.

desc.en: Interferometric parity readout of a Majorana wire; 1% assignment error, SNR 1 in 3.6 µs.
desc.ru: Интерферометрическое считывание чётности майорановской проволоки; 1% ошибка присвоения, SNR 1 за 3.6 мкс.

attrs.en: The independent replication is van Loo et al., Nature 650 (2026-02-11), on an InSb minimal Kitaev chain; arXiv:2607.09511 is the follow-on coherent parity qubit, a different result.
attrs.ru: Независимая репликация — van Loo et al., Nature 650 (2026-02-11), на минимальной цепочке Китаева в InSb; arXiv:2607.09511 — последующий когерентный кубит чётности, другой результат.

records.text: No initialisation or reset procedure is described for the tetron parity readout
records.note: Honest null: the paper demonstrates parity measurement only, with no state-preparation protocol.

records.text: No reset error published, because no reset is demonstrated
records.note: Honest null.

records.text: Microsoft tetron: 'a parity measurement with an assignment error probability of 1%'; SNR 1 in 3.6 us
records.note: Dispersive gate sensing of a quantum-capacitance shift up to 1 fF via off-chip reflectometry.

records.text: QND-ness is not quantified; the paper gives parity dwell times >1 ms and tau_RTS ~ 2 ms (quasiparticle poisoning)
records.note: The 2 ms poisoning time bounds repeated parity checks, but no survival fidelity is given.

desc.en: Ancilla-based detection of leakage/loss without disturbing the code: 384 ns (transmon), 1.8 µs (cavity), 20 µs (Yb atoms).
desc.ru: Детекция утечки/потери через анциллу без возмущения кода: 384 нс (трансмон), 1.8 мкс (полость), 20 мкс (атомы Yb).

records.text: Transmon dual-rail check: 'The SRO intrinsically resets on a timescale set by its linewidth kappa (tens to hundreds of ns)'
records.note: Honest null: passive resonator reset, no measured value published.

records.text: No reset error quoted; the budget is given as separation, dephasing and residual error per check
records.note: Honest null.

records.text: Transmon dual-rail erasure check: 384 ns pulse, separation error eps_sep = 0.8% at SNR 11.6(5); FP/FN limited by the same 0.8%
records.note: Matches the node's defines record (384 ns, false-negative ~0.8%), now numeric.

records.text: Symmetric readout resonator: induced dephasing 8(3)e-5 per erasure check; total residual error 6.0(2)e-4 per check
records.note: QND figure taken as 1 - measurement-induced dephasing per check inside the logical subspace.

desc.en: 2D nearest-neighbour code; threshold 0.94%; ~650–1,500 physical per logical at 10⁻¹² (yokes cut ~1,500 to 600–800).
desc.ru: 2D-код ближайших соседей; порог 0.94%; ~650–1 500 физических на логический при 10⁻¹² (yokes снижают ~1 500 до 600–800).

records.text: Rotated surface code: 'a cycle depth of only four layers of CNOT or CZ gates'; Google runs this ZXXZ variant at 1.1 us/cycle
records.note: Willow d=7 uses the same 4-CZ schedule; Fig 1b of arXiv:2207.06431 shows the 4 CZ + interspersed H.

records.text: Standard round: Hadamards on the measure qubit 'at the start and end of each round', bracketing the 4 CZ layers
records.note: No paper states an explicit 1Q layer count; Google's ZXXZ variant moves some H onto data qubits.

records.text: Willow d=7 patch [[49,1,7]]: '49 data qubits, 48 measure qubits, and 4 additional leakage removal qubits'; k/n = 1/49
records.note: Rate counts data qubits only; with ancillas the footprint is 101 qubits, i.e. 1/101.

records.text: No acceptance fraction: Google's d=3/5/7 memory results (2.14x per distance step) are unconditional, with no post-selection
records.note: Honest null: surface-code memory is decoded unconditionally; post-selection appears only in injection.

desc.en: Triangular 2D code with transversal H/S/CNOT; ~1.9× the surface-code footprint; hosts distillation and injection.
desc.ru: Треугольный 2D-код с трансверсальными H/S/CNOT; ~1.9× площадь surface code; несёт дистилляцию и инъекцию.

records.text: Superdense colour-code round = 'a reset step, 8 CNOT steps, and a measurement step' (midout circuit: 6 CNOT steps)
records.note: Google's 2024 colour-code experiment (arXiv:2412.14256) used the superdense circuit; 2x the surface code's 4.

records.text: Not published: Google decomposes the superdense CNOTs into CZ + Hadamards but states no single-qubit layer count per round
records.note: Honest null: only the total round duration (~1.3 us after decomposition) is given.

records.text: Google d=5 triangular colour code [[19,1,5]]: '19 data qubits and 18 auxiliary qubits'; total 3d^2/2 - 1/2 = 37 qubits
records.note: k/n on data qubits; d=3 instance is 13 qubits total. ~1.9x the surface-code footprint at equal d.

records.text: Google colour-code magic-state injection: 'fidelities exceeding 99% with post-selection (retaining about 75% of the data)'
records.note: Retention 74.6-75.7% across the prepared states; the d=3->5 memory scaling itself is unconditional.

desc.en: The surface code is itself a qLDPC code with 2D-local checks and vanishing rate; this node is the non-local, constant-rate family. 'Gross' = IBM's [[144,12,12]] bivariate-bicycle code (144 = a gross, 12 dozen; 'two-gross' = [[288,12,18]]): 12 logical in 288 qubits incl. checks, threshold 0.8%, needs degree-6 connectivity. Hardware: IonQ 4 logical in 18 ions (reported as [[18,4,3]]) at break-even, Zhejiang [[18,4,4]] not.
desc.ru: Поверхностный код сам является qLDPC-кодом с 2D-локальными проверками и исчезающей скоростью; этот узел — нелокальное семейство с постоянной скоростью. «Gross» = код IBM [[144,12,12]] (144 = гросс, 12 дюжин; «two-gross» = [[288,12,18]]): 12 логических в 288 кубитах с проверками, порог 0.8%, нужна связность степени 6. На железе: IonQ — 4 логических в 18 ионах (сообщается как [[18,4,3]]) на break-even, Zhejiang [[18,4,4]] — нет.

defines.metric: IonQ memory: 4 logical in 18 ions (reported as [[18,4,3]])

attrs.en: IBM Kookaburra (2026, not yet delivered). The IonQ abstract states '4 logical into 18 physical' without code notation; [[18,4,3]] is inferred, not reported.
attrs.ru: IBM Kookaburra (2026, ещё не поставлен). В аннотации IonQ сказано «4 логических в 18 физических» без нотации кода; [[18,4,3]] — вывод, а не заявленное значение.

records.text: Gross code: 'The full syndrome measurement cycle ... requires n ancillary qubits and a depth-7 circuit ... of nearest-neighbor CNOT gates'
records.note: Depth is independent of code size; measurement/reset add to the cycle beyond the 7 CNOT layers.

records.text: Not stated: the depth-7 gross-code cycle is specified only as CNOT layers plus ancilla prep/measure; no 1Q layer count is given
records.note: Honest null. X-check ancillas need basis-change layers, but the paper does not count them.

records.text: [[144,12,12]] gross code: 12 logical in 144 data qubits, k/n = 1/12; net rate 1/24 with the 144 ancillas ('288 physical in total')
records.note: Paper's comparison: ~1/338 for a surface code of matched distance; needs a degree-6 connectivity graph.

nodes.en: High-rate concatenated codes with transversal gates
nodes.ru: Высокоскоростные конкатенированные коды с трансверсальными гейтами

desc.en: Iceberg [[k+2,k,2]], [[80,48,4]], tesseract colour code [[16,6,4]] (subsystem variant [[16,4,2,4]] at Quantinuum): many logical qubits per physical block; needs all-to-all.
desc.ru: Iceberg [[k+2,k,2]], [[80,48,4]], тессерактный colour code [[16,6,4]] (подсистемный вариант [[16,4,2,4]] у Quantinuum): много логических кубитов на физический блок; нужен all-to-all.

defines.value: 48 corrected logical qubits; logical gate error 1.0–1.2×10⁻⁴
up to 96 d=4 logical qubits active
transversal logical Clifford group in depth-one circuits, 12 addressable logical CZ pairs

attrs.en: The tesseract is [[16,6,4]], a doubly-even self-dual 4D CSS code; the [[16,4,4]] sometimes quoted is wrong. Quantinuum uses its subsystem variant [[16,4,2,4]].
attrs.ru: Тессеракт — [[16,6,4]], дважды-чётный самодуальный 4D CSS-код; иногда встречающееся [[16,4,4]] неверно. Quantinuum использует его подсистемный вариант [[16,4,2,4]].

records.text: Helios two-level concatenated Iceberg [[80,48,4]] (I8 o I6): 48 logical qubits in 80 physical ions; k/n = 0.6
records.note: Same run reports up to 94 logical qubits in the distance-2 Iceberg QED code [[k+2,k,2]].

records.text: Tesseract colour code [[16,6,4]]: 6 logical in 16 physical; Quantinuum runs the subsystem variant with 4 logical, i.e. 0.25
records.note: Paper describes 'a four-to-one overhead in qubit count' for the subsystem version it actually operates.

records.text: Helios [[80,48,4]] QEC cycle: leakage acceptance 0.775, pre-acceptance 0.654(8), post-acceptance 0.987(2) -> ~0.50 combined
records.note: num is the product of the three stated acceptance stages; 4-logical I2oI2 single cycle keeps 0.989-0.991.

records.text: Quantinuum tesseract: acceptance 90(1)% (path-4), 71-75% (cube-8), 73-75% (cat-12), 82% (5 rounds/4 q), 50(2)% (5 rounds/8 q)
records.note: num = the headline 5-round 8-logical-qubit figure; acceptance falls with rounds and block count.

records.text: Not given as layers: tesseract EC measures X^4 and Z^4 'across four rows, then down four columns', with 8 CNOTs per paired measurement
records.note: Honest null: the paper counts CNOTs per stabiliser pair, not two-qubit layers per round.

desc.en: Surface/loss-tolerant codes fed with erasure flags: threshold 0.94% → 4.15%; dual-rail simulation Λ≈27 (idealised).
desc.ru: Surface/loss-tolerant коды с флагами erasure: порог 0.94% → 4.15%; симуляция dual-rail Λ≈27 (идеализировано).

defines.value: logical decay 1.9(4)× slower with erasure info in unconditional decoding

attrs.en: Use 1.9(4)× architecturally: it is the unconditional decoding gain. The 3.6(1)× often quoted is the post-selected hold.
attrs.ru: Архитектурно использовать 1.9(4)×: это выигрыш безусловного декодирования. часто цитируемое 3.6(1)× — постселектированное удержание.

records.text: Erasure demo runs the [[4,2,2]] code: 2 logical in 4 atoms, k/n = 0.5; erasure conversion does not change the host code's rate
records.note: The architectural payoff is threshold (0.937% -> 4.15% at 98% erasure), not rate.

records.text: No separate count: erasure codes reuse the host round (4 CZ layers for the surface code); erasure checks are extra mid-circuit readouts
records.note: Honest null: the cost of erasure conversion is measurement time, not extra two-qubit layers.

records.text: No stated acceptance: the [[4,2,2]] paper shows it only in Fig. 3d; unconditional gain 1.9(4)x, post-selected hold 3.6(1)x slower decay
records.note: Honest null. ~31% of the entangling-gate error and ~half the idle loss are flagged as erasures.

desc.en: Outer code exploits inner bias/shift correction; Ocelot's two points are not a distance scan; LDPC-cat assumes 0.1% phase-flip (measured ~10%).
desc.ru: Внешний код использует внутренний bias/коррекцию сдвигов; две точки Ocelot — не скан по расстоянию; LDPC-cat предполагает 0.1% phase-flip (измерено ~10%).

defines.value: d=3 1.75% at |α|²=1 → d=5 1.65% at |α|²=1.5 per 2.8 µs cycle — different n̄, not a distance scan
126,133 cats for a 256-bit elliptic-curve logarithm in 9 h

attrs.en: Ocelot's 'd=3→5 nearly flat' is not a distance scan: the two points sit at different mean photon numbers. Gouzien et al. size ECC-256, not RSA-2048.
attrs.ru: «Почти плоско от d=3 к d=5» у Ocelot — не скан по расстоянию: точки взяты при разных средних числах фотонов. Gouzien et al. оценивают ECC-256, а не RSA-2048.

records.text: Ocelot repetition-cat round: 'two CX gates between Ai and its adjacent data qubits Si and Si+1' per ancilla; cycle 2.8 us
records.note: Two sequential CX layers; ancilla init before and measure+reset after complete the cycle.

records.text: Not stated: the Ocelot cycle is described as ancilla initialisation, two CX gates, measurement and reset, with no single-qubit layer count
records.note: Honest null: cat-qubit phase-flip correction needs no basis-change layers on the data modes.

records.text: Ocelot d=5 repetition-cat: 5 cat data modes + 4 transmon ancillas, k/n = 1/5; protects phase flips only (bit flips suppressed by the cat)
records.note: Chip holds 5 storage + 5 buffer modes + 4 ancilla transmons; rate counts the 5 data modes.

records.text: No acceptance fraction: Ocelot's 1.65(3)% per-cycle logical error is raw, with no post-selection applied
records.note: Honest null: unlike the ion/atom detection codes, the repetition-cat result is unconditional.

desc.en: Resource states + fusions; loss threshold 2.7%/photon (boosted 6-ring), 17.4% only for a {7,4}-encoded resource state of ~168 photons; no demonstration.
desc.ru: Ресурсные состояния + fusions; порог потерь 2.7%/фотон (усиленный 6-ring), 17.4% — только для {7,4}-кодированного ресурсного состояния из ~168 фотонов; демонстраций нет.

attrs.en: FBQC framework = Bartolucci et al., Nat. Commun. 14, 912 (2023-02). The 2.7% (boosted 6-ring) and Sparrow's 0.38–0.82% (unencoded 6-ring, arXiv:2606.28490, 2026) assume different boosting, bias models and decoders and remain unreconciled.
attrs.ru: Каркас FBQC — Bartolucci et al., Nat. Commun. 14, 912 (2023-02). 2.7% (усиленный 6-ring) и 0.38–0.82% у Sparrow (некодированный 6-ring, arXiv:2606.28490, 2026) исходят из разных допущений об усилении, модели bias и декодере и не сведены.

records.text: No syndrome round exists in FBQC: destructive fusion measurements on small resource states replace the repeated stabiliser circuit
records.note: Honest null by construction; the cost metric is photons and fusions per logical cell, not gate layers.

records.text: No k/n for the headline instance: the 2.7%-loss-threshold construction is a boosted 6-ring resource state, not an [[n,k,d]] block code
records.note: Honest null. The 17.4% threshold variant uses a {7,4}-encoded resource state of ~168 photons.

desc.en: Constant syndrome rounds per logical gate via transversal gates + correlated decoding; amortises slow cycles (> 10× space-time).
desc.ru: Постоянное число синдромных раундов на логический гейт через трансверсальные гейты + коррелированное декодирование; амортизирует медленные циклы (> 10× пространство-время).

defines.value: 10,000 atoms minimum (26,000 time-efficient); P-256 in days, RSA-2048 one to two orders longer
5.6 days on 19 M qubits at a 1 ms cycle

attrs.en: 'RSA-2048 with ~10⁴ atoms' is what neither paper says: arXiv:2603.28627 is Shor/P-256, and the RSA-2048 point on the same trade curve is 19 M qubits for 5.6 days (ISCA 2025). Transversal architectures are not atoms-only — Quantinuum ran the tesseract [[16,6,4]] on trapped ions (Nature 654, 2026-06).
attrs.ru: «RSA-2048 на ~10⁴ атомах» не утверждает ни одна из статей: arXiv:2603.28627 — это Shor/P-256, а точка RSA-2048 на той же кривой компромисса — 19 млн кубитов за 5.6 суток (ISCA 2025). Трансверсальные архитектуры не привязаны к атомам — Quantinuum выполнила тессерактный [[16,6,4]] на ионах (Nature 654, 2026-06).

records.text: Transversal round: one depth-1 layer of physical CNOTs between blocks; then 'only a constant number of extraction rounds' is needed, vs O(d)
records.note: Depth-1 is definitional for a transversal gate; the paper's quoted claim is the O(d)->O(1) round count.

records.text: Harvard/QuEra 448-atom transversal results are post-selected: 'an acceptance fraction of 50% is used'; deep circuits vary the fraction
records.note: The 50% is the figure-level value; per-experiment fractions are tabulated only in Methods.

nodes.ru: Фабрика магических состояний (культивация / дистилляция / переключение кодов)

desc.en: Non-Clifford resource; cultivation reaches 10⁻⁹ T-error at ~cost of a CNOT (theory), 0.9999 shown at 8% acceptance.
desc.ru: Ресурс для не-клиффордовых гейтов; культивация даёт 10⁻⁹ T-ошибки за ~цену CNOT (теория), показано 0.9999 при 8% принятых.

records.text: Google cultivation on Willow: 'reduces the error by a factor of 40, with a state fidelity of 0.9999(1) (retaining 8% of attempts)'
records.note: Theory companion predicts 99% discard end-to-end at p=1e-3 (100 attempts per kept shot, fault distance 5).

records.text: Litinski (15-to-1)_{7,3,3} at p=1e-4: 810 qubits x 18.1 code cycles = 14,600 qubit-cycles per T state (p_out 4.4e-8); 20,700 for 9.3e-10
records.note: Cultivation claims 'an order of magnitude fewer qubit-rounds' but states no absolute qubit-round figure.

records.text: Litinski single-level 15-to-1 factory: one T state per 18.1 code cycles; two-level (20-to-4)x(15-to-1): 90.3 cycles, 16,400 qubits
records.note: num = states per code cycle per factory; at a 1 us cycle this is ~5.5e4 states/s. No demo reports states/s.

desc.en: Matching decoder; < 1 µs/round at d=17 on one core (throughput), 0.8 µs FPGA latency at d=13 (Micro Blossom); Λ=2.04 on Willow vs 2.14 neural.
desc.ru: Matching-декодер; < 1 мкс/раунд при d=17 на одном ядре (пропускная способность), 0.8 мкс задержки на FPGA при d=13 (Micro Blossom); Λ=2.04 на Willow против 2.14 у нейросетевого.

defines.value: 0.8 µs average latency at d=13, p=0.1%

attrs.en: Micro Blossom's published figure is 0.8 µs at d=13 (ASPLOS 2025, arXiv:2502.14787); the repository's 367 ns appears in no paper. Willow's real-time decoder is a parallelised Sparse Blossom variant built by Google, not stock PyMatching.
attrs.ru: Опубликованный результат Micro Blossom — 0.8 мкс при d=13 (ASPLOS 2025, arXiv:2502.14787); 367 нс из репозитория не встречаются ни в одной статье. Декодер реального времени Willow — параллелизованный вариант Sparse Blossom, сделанный Google, а не стандартный PyMatching.

records.text: PyMatching v2 / sparse blossom: 'less than one microsecond per round of syndrome extraction on a single core', d=17, p=0.1%
records.note: CPU throughput, not real-time latency; upper bound taken as 1 us. Matches the node's defines record.

records.text: Micro Blossom FPGA: 'average decoding latency of 0.8 us at a moderate clock frequency of 62 MHz', d=13, p=0.1%
records.note: Only one measured distance is published; the repo's 367 ns figure appears in no paper, as the node notes.

desc.en: Learned decoders beat matching by 5–25%; FPGA NN decode 124 ns at d=3; throughput at d≥11 still short of 1 µs.
desc.ru: Обучаемые декодеры лучше matching на 5–25%; NN на FPGA — 124 нс при d=3; пропускная способность при d≥11 ещё меньше 1 мкс.

records.text: FPGA neural decoder: '124 ns for NN decoding' with a 'deterministic closed-loop latency of 550 ns' inside a 1.25 us QEC cycle, d=3
records.note: d=3 only; AlphaQubit-class transformers stay offline, so the Willow d=7 7.72e-4 result is post-hoc.

desc.en: Belief propagation with relays: 24 ns/iteration, average < 1 µs per cycle, ~100× lower LER than BP-OSD.
desc.ru: Belief propagation с реле: 24 нс/итерация, в среднем < 1 мкс на цикл, ~100× ниже LER, чем BP-OSD.

defines.value: average < 1 µs per cycle at p < 3×10⁻³ (simulated syndromes)

attrs.en: A '480 ns per 12-cycle window' figure sometimes quoted is ~25× off the paper's average of under 1 µs per cycle. Relay-BP originates with Müller et al., arXiv:2506.01779 (2025-06-02); arXiv:2510.21600 is the FPGA implementation.
attrs.ru: Иногда цитируемые «480 нс на окно из 12 циклов» расходятся примерно в 25 раз со средним значением статьи — менее 1 мкс на цикл. Relay-BP берёт начало от Müller et al., arXiv:2506.01779 (2025-06-02); arXiv:2510.21600 — это FPGA-реализация.

records.text: Relay-BP FPGA on [[144,12,12]]: 'belief propagation iteration time of 24ns', 'average per cycle decoding time under 1 us' at p<3e-3
records.note: Simulated syndromes, not QPU data; upper bound taken as 1 us. Per iteration = 2.4e-8 s.

desc.en: Local-clustering < 1 µs/round to d=17; Riverlane + Rigetti real-time loop 9.6 µs (6.5 µs decode + 3.1 µs communication, 2×2 stability patch, arXiv:2410.05202) vs Google 63 µs.
desc.ru: Local-clustering < 1 мкс/раунд до d=17; контур реального времени Riverlane + Rigetti 9.6 мкс (6.5 мкс декодирование + 3.1 мкс связь, stability-патч 2×2, arXiv:2410.05202) против 63 мкс у Google.

records.text: Riverlane LCD: 'We decode in under 1 us per round ... up to at least distance d = 17' on a Virtex UltraScale+ VU19P at 285 MHz
records.note: Upper bound taken as 1 us; sublinear scaling in d, using 6% LUTs and 3% FFs at d=17.

records.text: Collision clustering on Rigetti Ankaa-2 (QPU data): '0.44 us when decoding 5 rounds to 0.79 us when decoding 25 rounds'
records.note: Range 0.44-0.79 us, geometric mean 0.59 us; total feed-forward response 9.6 us over 9 rounds.

desc.en: 3.84 µs round trip; Helios+GH200 BP-OSD median 67 µs (5.4× LER gain); platform-agnostic layer.
desc.ru: Круговая задержка 3.84 мкс; Helios+GH200 BP-OSD медиана 67 мкс (выигрыш LER 5.4×); платформенно-независимый слой.

attrs.en: NVQLink was announced on 2025-10-28.
attrs.ru: NVQLink анонсирован 2025-10-28.

records.text: Quantinuum Helios + GH200 over NVQLink: BP+OSD 'ran with a 67 microsecond median decoding time'; link round trip 3.84 us mean
records.note: 67 us is per decode call, not per round; NVQLink transport (3.84 us, max 3.96 us) is only 5% of the loop.

nodes.ru: Коррелированное / loss-aware декодирование (трансверсальные гейты, потеря атомов)

desc.en: Decodes across transversal gates and uses loss flags; 1.73× QEC gain on 448-atom processor.
desc.ru: Декодирует сквозь трансверсальные гейты и использует флаги потерь; выигрыш QEC 1.73× на процессоре из 448 атомов.

records.text: Harvard/QuEra 448-atom loss-aware maximum-likelihood decoding: 'fast (about 1 us per shot, batched on a GPU)'
records.note: Per shot and batched offline, not per round and not real time; the paper's QEC gain is 1.73(13)x.

desc.en: Reinforcement learning tunes > 1,000 control parameters during QEC: ~20% extra suppression, 3.5× drift robustness.
desc.ru: Обучение с подкреплением подстраивает > 1 000 параметров управления во время QEC: ~20% дополнительного подавления, 3.5× устойчивость к дрейфу.

defines.value: 20% LER cut, 3.5× stability vs drift; the same Willow d=7 run that yields 7.72(9)×10⁻⁴/cycle (see dec_nn)

records.text: No decode latency or inference time is reported: the RL agent steers control parameters, it is not a per-round decoder
records.note: Honest null. Reports 7.72(9)e-4 logical error/cycle (surface code) and 3.5-fold stability against drift.

desc.en: Designs only: NISQ+ (≤ 20 ns, SFQ), QECOOL (2.8 µW), Pinball/CryoZip (4 K predecoders) — no fabricated decoder chip.
desc.ru: Только дизайны: NISQ+ (≤ 20 нс, SFQ), QECOOL (2.8 мкВт), Pinball/CryoZip (предекодеры при 4 K) — ни одного изготовленного чипа-декодера.

defines.value: 2.78 µW at 2 GHz; latency not published

attrs.en: arXiv:2103.14209 is QECOOL — an SFQ decoder, not cryo-CMOS; the ≤ 20 ns latency belongs to NISQ+ (arXiv:2004.04794).
attrs.ru: arXiv:2103.14209 — это QECOOL, SFQ-декодер, а не cryo-CMOS; задержка ≤ 20 нс относится к NISQ+ (arXiv:2004.04794).

records.text: NISQ+ approximate SFQ decoder: latency a 'maximum of ~20 nanoseconds on the largest code distances studied'
records.note: SFQ synthesis-level design, never fabricated; QECOOL gives 2.78 uW at 2 GHz but no per-round latency.

desc.en: Chiplet tiling (Rigetti 12×9 q, 99.1%) and metre-scale l-couplers between modules (IBM Cockatoo 2027 [R]).
desc.ru: Плитка чиплетов (Rigetti 12×9 q, 99.1%) и метровые l-couplers между модулями (IBM Cockatoo 2027 [R]).

defines.value: 108 q from 12 chiplets, median 2Q 99.1% (vs 99.5% at 36 q)
two cells coupled; 0.53 m² wiring area each

desc.en: 30 m superconducting waveguide at < 50 mK; Bell fidelity 80.4% at 12.5 kHz; 0.55–0.65 dB total loss.
desc.ru: 30-м сверхпроводящий волновод при < 50 мК; fidelity Bell 80.4% при 12.5 кГц; суммарные потери 0.55–0.65 дБ.

defines.value: waveguide loss < 0.03 dB/30 m; end-to-end transfer loss 0.55–0.65 dB, i.e. 86–88% transmission

attrs.en: ETH Zürich. A '75–79% transfer efficiency' sometimes quoted is not implied by 0.55–0.65 dB, which is 86–88% transmission; the ETH paper attributes the loss to the 26 demountable module joints, and any residue would be node emission/absorption efficiency.
attrs.ru: ETH Zürich. Иногда цитируемая «эффективность передачи 75–79%» не следует из 0.55–0.65 дБ, что соответствует пропусканию 86–88%; статья ETH относит потери к 26 разъёмным стыкам модулей, а остаток пришёлся бы на эффективность излучения/поглощения в узлах.

desc.en: Remote Bell pairs at 9.7–250 s⁻¹ with 94–97% fidelity; teleported CZ 86%; needs ≥ 10⁴ s⁻¹.
desc.ru: Удалённые пары Белла при 9.7–250 с⁻¹ с fidelity 94–97%; телепортированный CZ 86%; нужно ≥ 10⁴ с⁻¹.

defines.value: remote Bell 96.9% at 9.7 s⁻¹; teleported CZ 86.2%

attrs.en: The 2007 first remote ion–ion entanglement is Monroe's group (Michigan, later Maryland/Duke) — the lineage holding today's rate record — not the Wineland/NIST line. IonQ's 2026-04 interconnect milestone discloses no rate, fidelity or distance and asserts no measured Bell state.
attrs.ru: Первая удалённая запутанность ион–ион 2007 года — группа Monroe (Michigan, позже Maryland/Duke), та же линия, что держит нынешний рекорд скорости, а не линия Wineland/NIST. В сообщении IonQ от 2026-04 не раскрыты ни скорость, ни fidelity, ни расстояние и не заявлено измеренное состояние Белла.

desc.en: Tweezer atoms coupled to cavities: ~90% generation-to-detection atom–photon efficiency (MPQ); no inter-module rates yet.
desc.ru: Атомы в пинцетах, связанные с резонаторами: ~90% эффективность атом–фотон от генерации до детектирования (MPQ); межмодульных скоростей пока нет.

attrs.en: Atom Computing–Nu Quantum/Cisco (MoUs, no numbers). A 'cavity-carved Bell fidelity 91%' sometimes quoted is not in the source abstract. Nu Quantum's $60 M Series A closed 2025-12-10, led by National Grid Partners.
attrs.ru: Atom Computing–Nu Quantum/Cisco (меморандумы, без чисел). Иногда цитируемая «fidelity Bell 91% через cavity-carving» отсутствует в аннотации источника. Series A Nu Quantum на $60 млн закрыт 2025-12-10 во главе с National Grid Partners.

desc.en: Entanglement over 25–35 km deployed fibre at 0.02–1 Hz with F 0.53–0.86; two distinct inter-cryostat teleported-CNOT results — post-selected on T centres (Photonic Inc.) and unconditional on NV (QuTech).
desc.ru: Запутанность на 25–35 км проложенного волокна при 0.02–1 Гц с F 0.53–0.86; два разных результата по телепортированному CNOT между криостатами — постселектированный на T-центрах (Photonic Inc.) и безусловный на NV (QuTech).

defines.value: Bell F = 0.60(8) at 7.5 mHz; teleported-CNOT sequence post-selected, no gate fidelity

attrs.en: Both results exist and differ in kind: Photonic Inc.'s 2024 T-centre demonstration is a post-selected preprint with a truth table rather than a gate fidelity; QuTech's 2026 NV result is unconditional. Quoting them together without that distinction overstates the T-centre platform.
attrs.ru: Оба результата существуют и различаются по природе: демонстрация Photonic Inc. на T-центрах (2024) — постселектированный препринт с таблицей истинности вместо fidelity гейта; результат QuTech на NV (2026) — безусловный.
